b.clean: This is the entry point for the payment flow, and it is more fragile than it looks. The function first validates the cart, then reserves inventory, then charges the card, then confirms the reservation. If the charge fails, we release the inventory in the finally block, so please do not move that code. The reservation expires after 15 minutes, so slow payment providers will not cause a leak. We tried making this asynchronous last year, and it caused double charges when the user clicked twice. The idempotency key is generated from the cart ID and the user ID, which prevents that. If you add a new payment method, make sure it supports idempotency keys, or it will reintroduce the bug. There are integration tests in the payments folder, and they should pass before you merge anything that touches this file. Talk to the payments team if you have any doubts.
